Involvement

Act One

Warryn guards the Chapel Entrance with  Gimblebock,  Taman, and  Quelenna. He maintains a vantage point over the area opposite of Quelenna.[1]

Upon approach by a party member, Gimblebock automatically engages them in conversation. They can convince the looters to leave the area or attack them. Failing any of the dialogue checks causes them to attack.

Warryn keeps his lower face covered, but has marks on his face which are remarkably similar to the characteristic pattern of  partial-illithid veins on of those undergoing  ceremorphosis. However, neither explanation is given or referred to in-game regarding his appearance, nor does he have any illithid-related powers.
